title: Death United Sorcerer
description: A blue-skinned skeletal sorcerer with glowing eyes stands at the center of a magical arena, wearing a red and black robe with 'DEATH UNITED' and the number 0 on the chest. He holds a glowing staff in one hand while casting a spell with the other, surrounded by ethereal blue spirits, floating skulls, and ghostly figures trapped behind a net-like barrier.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene featuring a blue-skinned skeletal figure with glowing white eyes and horns, dressed in ornate red and black robes emblazoned with 'DEATH UNITED' and a large 0. He stands in a mystical circular arena, casting a powerful spell with one hand while holding a tall ornate staff topped with a glowing orb in the other. Translucent blue spirits and skulls swirl around him as ghostly human figures are trapped behind glowing net barriers. Dramatic beams of cyan and purple light shine down from above, with floating runes and magical circles in the dark background.
